name: De L’Europe
insider_take: Where royal elegance meets Amsterdam's artistic soul along the legendary Amstel River.
whats_special: This historic palace hotel has hosted royalty since 1896 and sits on the same spot where Amsterdam's first luxury hotel welcomed guests in 1815. The property features Europe's only Michelin-starred hotel restaurant with stunning canal views and houses an impressive collection of Dutch Masters paintings throughout its opulent interiors.
pro_tip: Book a canal-view room on the Amstel River side – you'll wake up to the same waterway views that inspired Rembrandt, plus you can watch the daily parade of historic canal boats from your window.
dont_miss: The hotel's private jetty offers exclusive canal boat tours, and the legendary Freddy's Bar has been serving Amsterdam's cultural elite for decades. Step outside to explore the nearby Flower Market and you're just a 3-minute walk from Rembrandt's former home, now a fascinating museum.
pros: Iconic Canal-Front Location — Perfectly situated at the junction of the Amstel River and Keizersgracht canal, offering breathtaking waterway views in the heart of Amsterdam
Historic 19th-Century Grandeur — A landmark property dating back to 1896, blending timeless Dutch heritage with refined luxury interiors and architecture
World-Class Dining — Home to the celebrated Bord'Eau restaurant, offering a Michelin-starred culinary experience alongside multiple acclaimed dining and bar venues
Exceptional Spa & Wellness — Features a stunning indoor pool, fully equipped fitness center, and a luxurious spa offering a serene urban retreat
Unmatched City Access — Steps from top Amsterdam attractions including the Rijksmuseum, Anne Frank House, and world-famous shopping streets
cons: Premium Pricing — As one of Amsterdam's most prestigious luxury hotels, rates reflect the exceptional quality and location, best suited for high-end travelers
Urban City-Center Setting — Situated in a bustling central location, which may bring ambient city noise and lively street activity for lighter sleepers
